grn.text: Bozak, a mushroom harvester on his family's farmstead, hears that a new lich seeks an apprentice skilled at mushroom identification and sneaks away from his siblings to enter the contest.

Handed a map with twenty-five other competitors, he warns a few of them about woodwraiths, teams up with the kraul Limin and the gorgon Kata, and stabs Kata with his staff when she tries to petrify him.
Riding a deadbridge goliath, he reaches the lich first, and the lich declares both Bozak and Zegodonis his apprentices.

Months later he overhears the lich planning to frame Vraska for the Tin Street massacre, distracts him with a reanimated rat and flees to warn her, but he swallows the devouring angel mushroom and wakes controlled by the fungus, willing to serve Mazirek.
